bench_paid.label: Replicate, paid
bench_paid.plan: an account with billing set up
bench_paid.limits: One model that generates runs on this account: lightricks/ltx-2.5-fast, at 720p (its lowest resolution), one clip of 2 to 20 seconds per prediction. Models that generate nothing (they only read a frame from, cut, crop, resize, join or convert files you already have) also run: they are community models, run through create_predictions with the version given as owner/name:version. Create each prediction without the Prefer option, then read it with get_predictions until it finishes.

bench.label: Comfy Cloud
bench.limits: Only the LTX-2.5 model runs on this account: the templates video_ltx2_5_t2v (text to video), video_ltx2_5_i2v and video_ltx2_5_dfr_i2v (image to video) and video_ltx2_5_flf2v (first and last frame), through run_template, or your own workflow through submit_workflow built on LTX-2.5 with ordinary nodes (load, trim, last frame, join, text). Partner (paid API) models and other video models do not run.
